X1_D9b_stamps_every_Zoya_send.scenario: Zoya's inbound rows are almost never in ad@ (she logs only when Akshay is not on the mail), so D9b fires mainly on her own sends, which all reach ad@ via Akshay's Cc. 10:38 Zoya sends a holding reply (decision 390) on a bucket C thread and logs 'Zoya sent: ...'. 11:02 capture stamps it. 11:25 actions runs STEP 2b/5 on it, reads it as a team member closing Akshay's ask, takes Akshay off his decision; also re-moves Status/Waiting on that Zoya's STEP e/0e already moved (double write). Round 2 S1 reopened.
X1_D9b_stamps_every_Zoya_send.fix: capture STEP 1: 'such a row of Kind Email in without a "capture:" line (another routine logged it first; never a "Zoya sent:" row)'; STEP 0: 'There, and its Summary does not start "Zoya sent:": add the "capture:" line'; actions STEP 1: 'Skip ... any whose Summary starts "Zoya sent:"'.

quotes: capture CURSOR: 'from the newest inbox capture run record read only its Summary's "read to"'
actions STEP 1: 'plus rows Captured on or after the day before W's date'
X2_D9b_restamps_old_inbox_rows.scenario: First capture run finds no 'Run inbox capture' record, so T is 3 days back. Every message there was logged by the old inbox (no capture: line), so D9b stamps them all (stamps are uncapped). Rows Captured 31 Oct to 1 Nov 12:00 fall in actions' Captured window (W date 1 Nov) and are re-worked though the old inbox already worked them. D3/D3b reopened.
X2_D9b_restamps_old_inbox_rows.fix: STEP 1 exception: 'a row created since 2026-11-01 12:00 JST without a "capture:" line'; CURSOR: 'none yet: the old inbox's newest record (Source ID run:inbox:)'.

S1_captured_window_fetch_cost.quote: 'plus rows Captured on or after the day before W's date ... Fetch each, oldest created first. Yours only: its body has a "capture:" line'
S1_captured_window_fetch_cost.scenario: Every run body-fetches every Activity captured yesterday and today (done ones included, Zoya's too) inside a :25-:35 window; fetches eat the window, nothing closes, W and the window stay put: starvation.
S1_captured_window_fetch_cost.fix: 'plus rows created before 2026-11-02 and Captured on or after the day before W's date'.

S2_STEP0_rewrites_Captured.quote: 'Every row this step touches gets Captured today'
S2_STEP0_rewrites_Captured.scenario: Provenance (capture date) overwritten on old-inbox rows; for 'Not there: it is Zoya's, add nothing' rows either Captured is rewritten on Zoya's rows, or, if untouched, up to 8 stay oldest and take the msgid class's 8 slots every run.
S2_STEP0_rewrites_Captured.fix: Exclude in the query: Summary not starting 'Zoya sent:' and not containing ' to Zoya:'; record the original date in the body line ('captured-was <date>').

S3_fold_stamps_worked_row.quote: 'every one STEP 0 finds in ad@ ... ends its page body with the line "capture: <run id>"'
S3_fold_stamps_worked_row.scenario: Fold copies links onto an old-inbox msgid row (worked before 1 Nov 12:00), stamps and re-dates it; actions re-works it.
S3_fold_stamps_worked_row.fix: 'a found msgid row gets the line only if created since 2026-11-01 12:00 JST'.

S4_whatsapp_logged_before_send.quote: 'that key already on an Activity: it went, don't resend, just finish'
S4_whatsapp_logged_before_send.scenario: Crash between log ('Zoya sent: ...') and send: next run sees the key, never sends, reports done.
S4_whatsapp_logged_before_send.fix: Log as 'Zoya sending: <topic>', rename to 'Zoya sent:' after the send; a 'sending' row: check Akshay's chat for 'zoya here: <topic>' before resending.

S5_capture_stop_vs_step0.quote: 'STOP TIME: start no new message after :20' / 'STEP 0 ... before STEP 1, take up to 15'
S5_capture_stop_vs_step0.scenario: During the ~170-row drain STEP 0 can fill :02-:20; STEP 1 and loop-ins wait hours.

S6_dead_allmail_forever.quote: 'No Message-ID: add the body line "allmail: no Message-ID <date>" and leave it'
S6_dead_allmail_forever.scenario: Captured today only moves it to the back; once only these remain, every run re-reads up to 8 forever and can spend the 2 heavy RAW reads STEP 1 needs.
S6_dead_allmail_forever.fix: 'a row already marked "allmail: no Message-ID" is not taken again; count it as left'.
